hero.headline: The heart of Worthing, under one roof.
hero.subheadline: Independent retailers, family favourites and everyday essentials — Worthing's only indoor shopping centre, open seven days a week.

intro.heading: A different pace of shopping
body: The Guildbourne Centre is where Worthing comes to browse, meet and unwind. From handmade chocolate and silver jewellery to escape rooms and a science-backed fitness studio, our stores are run by people who know their craft — and know their customers.
Step inside and take your time. Everything is under one roof, minutes from the seafront, with the whole of Worthing town centre on the doorstep.

visit.heading: In the heart of Worthing
visit.body: You'll find us in the centre of town, a short stroll from the seafront and moments from Worthing's main shopping streets. Town-centre car parks and bus stops are a few minutes' walk away.
